features.title: Prove and persist a safe recording session
features.description: Run the required API 24, API 31, and target-API technical spike before implementation to prove one supported single-microphone path can produce one contiguous MediaRecorder file while feeding progressive STT windows; document the verified adapter and do not ship concurrent unsupported microphone clients. Then implement RECORD_AUDIO rationale/system/permanent-denial Settings flow, microphone feature guard, 128 MB StatFs preflight, app-private files/voice-notes storage and vn_{noteId}_{blockId}_{timestamp}.{m4a|ogg} naming, AAC default and format abstraction, VoiceNoteRecordingService as a LifecycleService with persistent notification Stop/Pause/Resume actions, singleton RecordingSessionManager, Recorder state reducer/ViewModel bridge, MediaRecorder pause/resume/stop/discard lifecycle, background survival, and cleanup of partial files/placeholders on discard or IO failure. Keep business logic out of Composables and expose stable semantics/test tags for every recorder control.
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can enter the production recorder state, grant or recover microphone permission, see the light-theme recorder with timer/waveform/controls, pause and resume from the app or notification, save or explicitly discard audio, and receive clear storage, microphone, or permission errors.

evidence.result: Passed: 1 instrumented Compose lifecycle test on emulator-5554 (API 33).
Passed: reducer pause/resume, save, illegal-transition, and discard scenarios.
Passed: 128 MB threshold, below-threshold blocking, and diagnostic byte count.
Passed: foreground service produced one non-empty private AAC file on API 33.

features.notes: Risk-first slice passed all listed verification commands. The source-compatible capture spike and API-33 runtime evidence are documented in spike-us1-capture.md; API-24/API-31/API-34 runtime certification remains pending because those emulator images were unavailable. This slice owns recorder lifecycle and audio persistence, not transcript concatenation or editor block rendering.

features.title: Show progressive transcription with safe fallback
features.description: Implement the verified STT adapter from US-1 behind an injectable interface, including 60-second overlapping windows, partial/final result handling, cursor-aware overlap deduplication, a 65-second silent-chunk watchdog, and cancellation on pause/stop/discard. Feed a StateFlow transcript preview into the production Recorder ViewModel and persist final text for later editor insertion. Detect API 31 on-device recognizer availability and API 24–30 offline preference behavior; show the specified warning and continue audio-only when the model is unavailable or an OEM callback is silent. Preserve the raw audio save path when a chunk fails and surface the exact failure copy.
features.user_visible_behavior: While recording, the live transcript preview appends recognized speech. If offline speech recognition is unavailable or a segment times out, recording continues, the user sees warning/fallback copy, and saved audio remains usable for manual transcript editing.

evidence.result: Passed: 3 overlap, partial-result, and boundary-fragment tests.
Passed: 2 production-boundary integration tests covering transcript fallback, timeout marker, saved transcript, and cancellation cleanup.
Passed: 1 Compose runtime fallback test on emulator-5554 (API 33), preserving recorder controls and showing unavailable-transcription warning.

features.notes: US-2 is passing. The injectable recognizer/session boundary consumes service-owned recording state, concatenates partial/final overlapping chunks, applies a 65-second watchdog and failure marker, preserves audio-only fallback copy, and cancels cleanly on discard. Android platform recognition availability is checked without opening a second microphone client; the existing US-1 MediaRecorder ownership boundary remains intact. Because the current US-1 capture path produces a compressed MediaRecorder file and no approved single-mic PCM tee exists yet, the production Android adapter safely reports source-unavailable instead of opening a concurrent SpeechRecognizer microphone client; the injectable boundary and deterministic fallback are ready for a future verified PCM bridge.

features.title: Start recording from Home or the editor
features.description: Update the existing HomeAddButton flow to open the standard light-theme ModalBottomSheet with Text Note and Record Note tiles, preserving the existing text-note route. Add stable home_add_fab, home_fab_sheet_title, home_fab_text_note, and home_fab_record_note contracts. Allocate and persist a placeholder note before Home recording, pass source context through navigation, and roll it back on discard. Wire the existing DefaultBottomBar Mic action in NoteEditorScreen with editor_mic_btn to open the recorder with current note context. Route all entry points through RecordingSessionManager so a newly selected context silently terminates and cleans up any existing session before starting the new one; add no confirmation for this context switch.
features.user_visible_behavior: Tapping Home’s add button shows Create with Text Note and Record Note. Record Note opens the recorder for a new-note context; the editor’s bottom-toolbar Mic opens it for the current note; switching contexts replaces the active recording with a clean new session.
features.notes: Depends on US-1 recorder launch contract. This slice owns entry/navigation and placeholder-note lifecycle; it does not own the saved VoiceNote player.

features.title: Save and edit inline VoiceNote blocks
features.description: Add the Room voice_note_block entity/DAO/repository mapping with nullable audioFilePath, audioFormat, duration, size, sample-rate, channel, and timestamps; add the document Voice metadata block paired with existing EditorBlock.TextBlock transcript sibling. Implement Stop-save insertion at the focused editor position and Home-save insertion at document position 0 with navigation to the new note. Build the Media3 ExoPlayer-backed inline VoiceNotePlayer card with play/pause, seek, elapsed/total labels, file size, missing-file state, and delete-audio-only confirmation. On audio-only delete set audioFilePath to null, remove only the player card, and keep the TextBlock; on transcript/block or note deletion delete associated private files in the same repository operation. Add integration and instrumented coverage for complete production paths.
features.user_visible_behavior: Stopping a recording inserts an inline audio player and editable transcript. Users can play, pause, seek, edit the transcript, delete only audio while keeping text, or delete the note and have all private audio files cleaned up.
features.notes: Depends on US-1 audio lifecycle, US-2 final transcript events, and US-3 source context/navigation. The canonical transcript type is the existing EditorBlock.TextBlock; do not introduce EditorBlock.RichText.

features.title: Configure Voice Notes and verify the completed Light Theme flow
features.description: Append the Voice Notes section to the existing Settings screen using current settings row/card patterns and no new component family. Persist AAC/OPUS selection atomically in DataStore, expose total private voice storage from the repository, show per-format quality/bitrate information, and make the next recording honor the selected format with AAC fallback copy on unsupported codecs. Complete final cross-surface integration wiring and deterministic visual-verification tests so Home sheet, Recorder in-progress, Editor inline VoiceNote, and Settings Voice Notes are reachable through production navigation and captured only after state assertions. Compare UI chrome against all four v3 mockups and updated design_system.md tokens.
features.user_visible_behavior: Settings shows Voice Notes storage and format controls; changing AAC/OPUS persists for future recordings. The complete Home → Recorder → Editor and Settings journey is reachable in the updated Light Theme and remains accessible/responsive.
